headline: Argentine Court Dismisses $LIBRA Crypto Case Involving President Milei
summary: An Argentine federal court dismissed the $LIBRA cryptocurrency case, clearing President Javier Milei and ten other suspects, in a ruling criticized by the opposition and alleged victims.
why: Judicial and political controversies surrounding high-profile crypto schemes impact regulatory credibility and investor sentiment toward domestic governance in Argentina.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Dismissal of high-profile legal cases affects institutional trust and regulatory perception.
